summary: Oriented in the captured etcd-raft snapshot and traced the follower leader/lease context (r.lead): its only legitimate producer is the local ForgetLeader API, yet pb.MsgForgetLeader is absent from isLocalMsg, so the module's inbound filter (RawNode.Step/node.Step) accepts a peer-supplied message of that type, Step treats it as a term-0 local message, and stepFollower clears r.lead. Registered one sourced investigation, three knowledge entries (inbound filter set, forget-leader producers, lease suppression in Step), one necessary gap (window length and quorum reachability), a conditional/asserted interpretation, and one fixed experiment with five comparisons (local-type control, under-lease control, acceptance predicate, post-forget consequence, local-API control) whose harness (draft/assurance_generated_test.go, package raft_test, real RawNode election/heartbeat/campaign producers) ran natively with the predicted events. Incomplete: the controller receipt for that experiment is not yet available, so the account is source-plus-native-probe based and the registered gap is unanswered.
